canonical_statement: Let X_n be finite-dimensional real random elements, theta a fixed center, r_n positive real numbers tending to infinity, and Z a finite-dimensional real random element. If r_n (X_n - theta) converges in distribution to Z and the measurable map g is Frechet differentiable at theta with derivative g', then r_n (g(X_n) - g(theta)) converges in distribution to g'(Z).

conclusion: TendstoInDistribution (fun n omega => r n • (g (X n omega) - g theta)) atTop (fun omega => g' (Z omega)) (fun _ => mu) mu'
